study type: National cohort study and survey of practice
outcome: Composite maternal outcome (augmentation, instrumental birth, caesarean birth, maternal blood transfusion, third or fourth-degree perineal tear, maternal admission to higher level care)
cohort: Women admitted for labour care to midwifery units in the UK, comparing those with gestational or pre-existing diabetes to those without diabetes.
finding: Women with diabetes admitted for labour care to midwifery units were not significantly more likely to experience the composite primary outcome reflecting the need for obstetric care compared to women without diabetes.
mod_finding: Women with diabetes admitted to midwifery units were not more likely to experience instrumental birth or caesarean birth as part of the composite primary outcome compared to women without diabetes.
